facts.summary: Phase 2 missed primary endpoint, program halted · Phase 2 · FB-401 in atopic dermatitis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: topline data from its Phase 2 clinical trial of FB-401 for the treatment of atopic dermatitis failed to meet statistical significance for the primary endpoint of EASI-50
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The primary endpoint of EASI-50 was achieved by 58% of subjects on FB-401 compared to 60% of subjects on placebo (p=0.7567).
evidence.program_discontinued: given this readout we will not continue to advance FB-401.
